SELECT
p.payment_id, p.transaction_id, p.customer_id, p.order_id, p.payment_method, p.payment_status, p.amount, p.upi_id, p.payment_date,
c.user_id AS customer_id, c.user_name AS customer_name, c.user_email AS customer_email, c.user_phone AS customer_phone, c.wallet_balance,
o.order_id, o.quantity, o.total_price, o.order_status, o.order_date,
pr.product_id, pr.product_name, pr.product_description, pr.product_price, pr.product_status
FROM payment p
INNER JOIN customers c ON p.customer_id = c.user_id
INNER JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
INNER JOIN products pr ON o.product_id = pr.product_id
WHERE p.payment_id = #{paymentId}
